maddeler.e:
تتبحبحوا (form IIq)
# تَتَبَحْبَحُوا (tatabaḥbaḥū) /ta.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُتَبَحْبَحُوا (tutabaḥbaḥū) /tu.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
